messages.author: f8f554f3c8aec296
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: Watershed mapping
parts:
Yes!

Best starting place IMO is Hijmans' raster package  http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/raster/index.html (check the vignette).
You'll also need gdal/rgdal to deal with projections.
